raw.details:
India AI Open 2026 by AccioJob: Proof, Not Resume

India AI Open by AccioJob is a free, national AI talent contest for students and early-career engineers. You don't send a resume. You build something real, explain how you built it, and win ₹50,000 for 1st, ₹25,000 for 2nd and ₹15,000 for 3rd, plus more cash prizes and get Job Opportunity of Up-to 50LPA and Interships Up-to 1Lakh/Month.

It is solo, it is online, and it takes you through two rounds: a Test with an AI interview, then a short build with an AI walkthrough. AI tools are allowed. What gets scored is your judgment: where you used AI, why, and whether the result holds up.

Not just another hackathon: there are no teams, no all-nighters and no pitch decks. Just you, a real problem and proof of how you solve it.

Who can take part

  • Students in any year and engineers with up to 5 years of tech experience
  • Any college, any stream
  • Individual participation only
  • Free to enter
  • Working? Your current employer is never told you took part.

Choose one of five tracks

Every track has two levels. Build is for students and engineers with up to 2 years of experience. Scale is for engineers with 2+ years, or anyone who wants a harder problem. You can change your track and level until 11 Dec 2026, 11:59 PM IST. Below are the examples of what you will build.

1. AI Engineer

  • Build: A support agent that answers from store policies and live order data, and hands risky questions to a human. Judged on hidden test questions.
  • Scale: Make an unreliable agent reliable with evals and guardrails, at the same cost per reply.

2. Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)

  • Build: Fix 2,000 messy delivery complaints for a logistics client, plus an honest one-page note.
  • Scale: One codebase that serves 3 clients.

3. Software Engineer (Backend)

  • Build: A microservice that spins up a microVM in 500 ms. Hidden tests include duplicate and failure cases.
  • Scale: 100 microVMs, concurrent requests and a load test with zero double charges.

4. Full Stack Developer

  • Build: A clinic booking app with zero double-booked slots, where AI summarises notes.
  • Scale: 50 clinics with isolated data, permissions and pages that load under 2 s on 3G.

5. Data Analyst

  • Find out why a store's sales dropped in March from 12 months of messy data. Deliver 3 charts and 1 recommendation.
  • Same challenge at both levels; your level decides which roles open to you.

Pick your level

  • Build: Students and engineers with up to 2 years of experience
  • Scale: Engineers with 2+ years, or anyone who wants a harder problem

You are ranked only against others in your own level. Experience is checked. You can change your track and level until 11 Dec 2026, 11:59 PM IST.

How it works

  • Register by 11 Dec 2026, 11:59 PM IST. Try the Sample Test to see the format.
  • Round 1 (Test + AI interview): 12 to 13 Dec 2026. Camera and mic on, face visible, one screen, no one else in the room.
  • Round 1 results: 21 Dec 2026. Qualifiers unlock the Round 2 brief.
  • Round 2 (build + AI walkthrough): Build solo from 21 Dec; submissions due 26 Dec 2026, 11:59 PM IST. Start a new repo after 21 Dec; your commit history is reviewed. Then record one AI walkthrough of about 15 to 20 minutes.
  • Final results: 11 Jan 2027. Roles open the same day; company interviews start from 12 Jan 2027.

What you get

  • A proof report for every builder: Your score, what was checked and what to fix
  • The option to apply to roles after results. Companies see your report only if you apply to them.
  • Full-time roles with pay up to ₹50 LPA and internships up to ₹1 lakh a month for top performers.
  • Cash prizes: ₹50,000 for 1st, ₹25,000 for 2nd and ₹15,000 for 3rd, plus more cash prizes.

Rules in short

  • Solo only. No teams, no help from anyone else during either round.
  • AI tools are allowed. Explain where and why you used them.
  • Round 1: Camera and mic on, face visible, one screen, no one else in the room.
  • Round 2: New repo after 21 Dec, commit history reviewed, one walkthrough attempt.
  • The official rules page is final on any conflict: https://go.acciojob.com/UEt2UL
